    ABOUT US

    Established in 2001, Goblin has built its trust and goodwill in the luggage industry by providing the best and the latest travelling gear solutions to its customers. Over the years, Goblin has become one of the top brands in India by providing strong and durable luggage along with corporate promotion solutions. With its headquarters and manufacturing plant based in the city of Ahmedabad, Gujarat, it has gained a significant foothold in the local markets as well as across the nation. Goblin currently has over 525 dealers across India and over 300 dealers in France. With the help of constant efforts, Goblin aims to automate and innovate its range of products making travelling user-friendly for all its customers.
